per_article_summaries: Liam Lawson has spoken about his two-race stint at Red Bull. The 24-year-old was Max Verstappen's team-mate at the start of 2025. Lawson said it is hard to trust people in the Formula 1 paddock.

Brundle warns that the altitude of the Red Bull Ring may exacerbate Mercedes' power unit reliability concerns. Mercedes have had a string of retirements, including those of George Russell at the Canadian Grand Prix and Kimi Antonelli at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix. Brundle: "We're 600m high here in Spielberg. Air is about 8% thinner"

George Russell takes pole position for Austrian Grand Prix. Mercedes driver avoided an investigation for setting his lap under yellow flag conditions following Max Verstappen’s crash. Verstappen spun into the barrier at the penultimate corner, benefiting those who’d already set their lap or Russell, who was just behind him.

Kimi Antonelli missed out on a front-row start for the Austrian Grand Prix. The Italian mistook the yellow flag for a double yellow and aborted his lap. Mercedes team-mate George Russell will start the race from pole position.

F1 chief Bernie Ecclestone backs move to bigger, louder and cheaper engines. FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem and F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali want to switch to a V8 engine by 2030 or 2031. Ecclestone believes there will be enough support from F1's manufacturers to push the changes.

Mercedes driver George Russell will not be investigated by the FIA race stewards for setting his pole lap under local yellow flags brought out by Max Verstappen. Red Bull's Verstappen crashed in the final moments of qualifying as he made a last-ditch attempt to battle the Mercedes drivers for pole. The stewards appeared to be satisfied that Russell had reduced speed in the relevant marshal sectors.

Carlos Sainz reveals how he separates his off-track friendships from his on-track rivalries. The Spaniard says he only sees rival cars rather than the specific driver when he is racing. Sainz formed a well-documented, fan-favourite friendship with Norris, affectionately known as 'Carlando', during their stint as McLaren team-mates.

Mercedes driver George Russell claims Toto Wolff's 'just drive' radio message was a way to encourage him. The Briton went on to secure pole position for the Austrian Grand Prix. Russell is currently third in the championship, 50 points behind title favourite Kimi Antonelli.

Max Verstappen believes his crash in Austria GP should have triggered double yellow flags earlier. The FIA has explained that the standard procedure was followed. Verstappen lost control of his RB22 on the entry to Turn 9 after already experiencing a significant snap three corners earlier.

Juan Pablo Montoya believes Fernando Alonso faces a huge risk if he chooses to leave Aston Martin. The two-time Formula 1 champion could live to regret walking away. Alonso has been open about considering retirement in the not-too-distant future. The Spaniard is currently 18th in the drivers' championship.

Red Bull driver Max Verstappen says his car was "immediately gone" as he suffered a costly accident in qualifying ahead of the Austrian Grand Prix. The Dutchman lost the rear of his Red Bull RB22 in Turn 9, spinning into the barriers. Verstappen felt the crash cost him two positions on the starting grid, but given Red Bull's well documented start issues he was expecting to drop back.

Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya has warned that Mercedes may need to rethink its development strategy. Montoya argues that the Brackley outfit must begin delivering upgrades "quicker" to avoid falling behind in the mid-season development race. Montoya spoke ahead of the Austrian Grand Prix on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-up show.

Stefano Domenicali hosted the F1 drivers' dinner on Thursday evening. The dinner has become a regular part of the Austrian Grand Prix weekend. All 22 drivers were in attendance along with Domenicali. Fans were quick to react after the official group photograph was shared on social media.

The engine set to power Formula 1 cars from 2031 will have to find a balance between these two aspects. Some are calling for a power unit conceived purely for racing and entertainment. Others are investing hundreds of millions of euros in technologies that must retain a connection to mass‑production road cars.

Kimi Antonelli was fastest in final practice session ahead of qualifying. Lewis Hamilton was the fastest non-Mercedes driver in the session. Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri and Max Verstappen completed the top five.

Mercedes boss Toto Wolff confirms his desire to retain George Russell and Kimi Antonelli for the 2027 Formula 1 season. Verstappen's future was a hot topic last year due to the various exit clauses in the four-time world champion’s Red Bull contract. But when they were no longer valid, the Dutchman publicly committed to Red Bull for 2026.

Paul Monaghan is set to leave Red Bull to join the Cadillac Formula 1 team. The move is effectively finalised, but no formal resignation has been submitted to the Milton Keynes team. Monaghan is carrying out his duties as usual in the Red Bull garage.

Ferrari's Charles Leclerc is not expecting a 'magic bullet' from engine upgrade. The new ADUO system was introduced for the 2026 season. Red Bull was deemed the surprise benchmark with Mercedes 2-4% behind on power. Ferrari, Audi and Honda are over 4% off granting them two upgrades.

George Russell claims his second victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season. The Mercedes driver crossed the line 1.6 seconds clear of Red Bull's Max Verstappen. Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli completed the podium.

Sergio Perez wore a Venezuela sticker on his helmet for the Austrian Grand Prix. Perez was among many to pay tribute to the victims of the earthquakes in Venezuela. The official death toll has already risen above 1400, and tens of thousands are still reported missing.

Oscar Piastri was sent to the stewards at 5:10pm local time on Sunday. The McLaren driver finished fourth at the Red Bull Ring. Piastri was accused of driving too slowly during his reconnaissance laps. But the FIA opted to not take any further action.

George Russell wins 2026 Austrian Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli still leads F1 drivers' championship by 40 points. Lewis Hamilton reclaims second place from Oscar Piastri. Mercedes lead constructors' standings by 100 points. Cadillac remains the only team without a point.

Fernando Alonso qualifies 21st for the Austrian Grand Prix. Spaniard will start third on the grid behind Lance Stroll and Sergio Perez. Aston Martin's debutant team will not make upgrades until later in the summer. Alonso says he is 'always positive' despite poor start to season.

All the results and standings from the 2026 F1 Austrian Grand Prix Discover the full results and standings from the Austrian Grand Prix. The Austrian Grand Prix is the eighth round of the 2026 Formula 1 season. Click here for the full results and standings.

Jolyon Palmer says Ferrari could have the best car by the end of the season. The former F1 driver praised the team's aggressive development curve. Palmer won his first race as a Ferrari driver at the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix. Lewis Hamilton has not ruled out a title fight with Mercedes.

Mercedes team chief Toto Wolff describes George Russell as 'cold-blooded' Russell claimed his first grand prix win since the season-opener in Australia. Teenage team-mate Kimi Antonelli took the lead of the championship after back-to-back wins.

Mercedes re-established its lead in the title race with George Russell's victory in Austria. Kimi Antonelli's misfortune in Spain brought the gap down to 50 points. Red Bull's upgrades delivered exactly what the team had hoped for. Ferrari's power unit upgrade wasn't enough to keep fans dreaming of a title fight.
